question: Can two action-conditioned, fully measured three-edge histories with the same initial error, complete first public record and final support have different complete next-first public Born laws?
role: Smallest additional topology after J7E: one preselected positive first record, two registered action/future-fault branches, exact complete public second/next laws; not isolated action causality or noisy schedule performance
source_basis: Jing Appendix A.2/A.4 ideal red-X and charge projectors
J7F positive first-state witness and J7E measured-branch null

model.physical_state: Periodic L=2 J6M 108-qubit common +1 star/triangle vacuum orbit; private initial physical red-X error edges [0,4,3]; exact ideal projectors and no readout noise
model.first_observation: Exactly the J7F preregistered positive complete 24-site binary first record for the three-edge chain: charge 0 at individually random sites 1 and 2, all other eligible sites fixed; exact mass 1/4. No adaptive first-record choice
model.branch_a: Relation-free public correction edge [0], measure the complete actual-sector second public record on residual [4,3], then apply one private later red-X fault edge 0; final support [0,4,3]
model.branch_b: Relation-free public correction edge [4], measure the complete actual-sector second public record on residual [0,3], then apply one private later red-X fault edge 4; final support [0,4,3]
model.private_public_boundary: Physical/future faults, operator masks, orbit and projector state are private. Only complete 24-site binary flux/charge/vacuum arrays, declared public action and causal digests are public; no relation oracle or hidden-history decoder input
model.matched_keys: Both branches share the exact initial physical geometry and selected complete first public record and end with the same final red-X support. Each branch has its own predeclared later physical-fault key and complete second outcome law; do not claim a same-exogenous-future causal action effect
model.independent_unit_uncertainty: One exact finite orbit and one complete first record, not statistical replicates; rational Born masses and exact total variation require no Monte Carlo interval

matrix.second_and_next: For each branch, classify every actual-sector eligible second and next star by exact chronological projector moments; enumerate the complete joint Born law over all non-deterministic sites into full 24-site public records; normalize at every positive prefix and marginalize the complete second law
matrix.discriminator: Exact rational total variation between the two complete next-first public laws conditional on the identical selected first record; separately verify the J7F one-site prediction (next site 1 is fair in A and deterministic +1 in B) and retain J7E/J7C exact nulls without pooling
matrix.integrity: Before/after source pins, actual-sector eligibility and same-sector commutation, positive first mass, all full-law normalization, public/private/action/future-key binding negative controls and deterministic replay; frozen caller unchanged

competing_outcomes.finite_full_public_difference: Both branch laws close and exact TV > 0; this establishes a finite ideal matched-initial/final-support history dependence of the public next-first law, not isolated action causality, an integrated D4 channel or noisy JIT advantage
competing_outcomes.finite_null: Both full laws close and exact TV = 0 despite the J7F one-site prediction; investigate identity/control inconsistency before claiming a null
competing_outcomes.censored: Any source, first/second/next public law, binding, replay, compute or model gate fails; no contrast inference or adaptive cap enlargement

acceptance: Eight pins pass before and after; J7F complete first public record and exact first mass reproduce
Both full action-conditioned second public laws normalize at the actual residual sectors
Every positive-prefix full next-first public law normalizes at the common final sector and agrees with the predeclared one-site prediction
Exact complete-record TV is evaluated only after both branches and binding/replay controls pass; J7E/J7C nulls stay separate
Frozen caller unchanged; no stochastic histories, schedule arms, bootstrap, threshold or general stateful-channel claim
stop_rule: Censor at any original CPU, term, variable-site or row cap. Fail closed on pin, geometry, eligibility, first-mass, Born-law, binding, replay or one-site prediction drift. No alternative first record, additional topology, caller integration, noisy sampling or post-hoc budget increase.
